records.accepted_name: Oenothera capillifolia subsp. berlandieri (Spach) W.L.Wagner & Hoch
records.caution: Homotypic synonym of accepted subsp. berlandieri. Species-level Oenothera capillifolia canonical card does not establish the subspecies identity of every specimen; distinct from subsp. capillifolia. Historical Oenothera berlandieri is an illegitimate later homonym.
records.learner_action: Infraspecific alias/handoff for installer concept check; do not install duplicate Calylophus card or relabel existing species-level photos.
